# VK Vigglorious Studio

## Vigglorious Nodes

### VK Vigglorious Video Manager

Loads and trims the driving video, previews the cut and chunk boundaries, and assigns reference frames and optional guides. Each selected frame keeps its character, head/body angles, swap mode and additional prompts. Choose a clear, well-swapped reference for each chunk, then add ordinary guides sparingly around difficult poses or identity changes.

### VK Vigglorious Character Manager

Organizes a local character library with separate head and full-body reference angles. Connect its reference collections to Video Manager so each reference or guide can use an appropriate character and view. Character saves contain image references; the image files remain in the local ComfyUI input directory.

### VK Vigglorious Load Image

Loads a single image with upload, paste, recent-image browsing and optional resizing. In this workflow it provides the optional already-swapped reference: use an edited frame from the same driving video, keeping the original pose, framing and lighting.

### VK Vigglorious Extract Chunk State

Reads the current loop state and supplies the chunk conditioning, continuation latent, seeded noise and frame information to the external sampler path. It carries the preceding chunk context forward so the next chunk can continue the sequence.

### VK Vigglorious Prepare Chunk Guides

Collects the selected reference and guides for the current chunk and emits their source frames, character images, swap switches and additional prompts. Its guide_positions output carries their positions and target resolution to Attention-Masked Guide. Preserve frame order through the swap and mask paths; an assigned reference may reuse the initial swapped reference when reuse_initial_reference is enabled.

### VK Vigglorious Extract Chunk Frames

Extracts the original video frames for the current chunk, including overlap and any final-frame padding. This optional helper supplies the complete source-frame batch when experimenting with source-video masks; it does not replace the masks computed on swapped guides.

### VK Vigglorious Guide Mask

Segments each swapped guide using its selected concept, such as head/hair or person, and returns masks in the same order as the guide images. Disabling masking for a guide skips segmentation and uses the full image. Masks focus guidance on the edited region but cannot correct a poor swap.

### VK Vigglorious Attention-Masked Guide

Encodes the swapped images into H3 conditioning: an assigned chunk reference replaces the native image reference, while ordinary guides are placed at their selected video positions. Optional masks restrict direct guide attention, and a connected sigma sequence enables per-step ON/OFF switches and attention factors. Start cautiously at high sigma, then compare stronger later guidance; these controls do not apply to the native chunk reference.

### VK Vigglorious Patch Guide Attention

Patches the H3 model through ComfyUI’s model patcher so sampling can apply guide masks and attention factors, plus the optional RefMod attention modes. Place it on the model path after model LoRAs and before the guider. It enables the controls; the conditioning nodes supply the masks and schedules.

### VK Vigglorious Sigma Scheduler

Edits the complete sampling sigma sequence through a synchronized curve and numeric list. N sampling steps require N+1 sigma values; changing the step count resamples the curve while preserving its endpoints. Share the same schedule with sampling and per-step guidance, and treat sigma/scheduler choices as experimental settings rather than a proven optimum.

### VK Vigglorious Wrapper Schedule RefMod Apply

Optionally applies compatible RefMod bundles on a per-step schedule. It supports latent strength, native attention bias and an experimental residual-attention mode; the meanings of their values differ. Attention modes require Patch Guide Attention, and the external RefMod apply/picker packages are needed only when using this optional path.

### VK Vigglorious Chunk Finish

Checks and checkpoints the sampled video/audio latents, records their chunk order and seed, then advances the loop state. It also supplies a video-only latent for preview decoding and a unique filename prefix. Saved checkpoints support later assembly or recovery; re-queuing this external-sampler workflow samples again.

### VK Vigglorious RefMod Attention Apply (internal)

An internal helper used by Wrapper Schedule RefMod Apply to attach the selected RefMod attention behavior to conditioning. The wrapper creates and manages this path; it does not need manual wiring in a normal workflow.

### VK Vigglorious RefMod Step Conditioning (internal)

An internal helper that supplies the wrapper’s RefMod conditioning for each sigma interval. It keeps per-step selection with the scheduled conditioning path and is managed by the wrapper rather than added manually.

## Packages required by the included workflow

Install these packages and their own requirements using ComfyUI's Python, then fully restart ComfyUI and refresh the browser. Studio includes every VK node used here; no other VK extension is required.

- [ComfyUI](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI), recent version with native H3, Qwen Image 2.1 and SAM3 support.
- [ComfyUI-Viggle-Animate-H3](https://github.com/bhardwajRahul/ComfyUI-Viggle-Animate-H3).
- [ComfyUI-KJNodes](https://github.com/kijai/ComfyUI-KJNodes).
- [rgthree-comfy](https://github.com/rgthree/rgthree-comfy).
- [Rebalance Pack](https://github.com/nova452/Rebalance-Pack).
- [VideoHelperSuite](https://github.com/Kosinkadink/ComfyUI-VideoHelperSuite).

FFmpeg with **libx264** is also required. Native SAM3 is part of ComfyUI; a separate KJ SAM3 extension is not used. Custom Scripts and RefMod extensions are not required by this example.

## Models and LoRAs for the included workflow

The example uses public filenames directly in the folders below, without private subfolders. Select the installed files in the loader menus, including loaders inside both Qwen subgraphs. No weights or source media are included or downloaded automatically.

| Folder under `ComfyUI/models/` | File selected in the example | Source |
|---|---|---|
| `diffusion_models/` | `minimax_h3_ref2va_viggle_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors` | [Viggle ComfyUI models](https://huggingface.co/drbaph/Viggle-Animate-ComfyUI/tree/main/diffusion_models) |
| `loras/` | `viggle_animate_dmd_lora_r64.safetensors` | [Viggle DMD LoRAs](https://huggingface.co/drbaph/Viggle-Animate-ComfyUI/tree/main/loras) |
| `text_cond/` | `fixed_embed_fwd_anyframe.safetensors` | [Viggle frozen conditioning](https://huggingface.co/drbaph/Viggle-Animate-ComfyUI/tree/main/text_cond) |
| `vae/` | `minimax_h3_video_vae_fp16.safetensors` | [H3 VAEs](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/tree/main/vae) |
| `diffusion_models/` | `qwen_image_2.1_int8_convrot.safetensors` | [Qwen Image 2.1](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Qwen-Image-2.1/tree/main/diffusion_models) |
| `text_encoders/` | `qwen3vl_8b_int8_convrot.safetensors` | [Qwen text encoders](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Qwen-Image-2.1/tree/main/text_encoders) |
| `vae/` | `qwen_image_2.1_vae_bf16.safetensors` | [Qwen VAE](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Qwen-Image-2.1/tree/main/vae) |
| `loras/` | `bfs_head_v1.1_qwen_2.1.safetensors` | [BFS head swap](https://huggingface.co/Alissonerdx/BFS-Best-Face-Swap/blob/main/bfs_head_v1.1_qwen_2.1.safetensors) |
| `loras/` | `bfs_body_swap_v1.0_qwen_2.1.safetensors` | [BFS body swap](https://huggingface.co/Alissonerdx/BFS-Best-Face-Swap/blob/main/bfs_body_swap_v1.0_qwen_2.1.safetensors) |
| `loras/` | `p_qwen_image_2.1_8step_v0.1_comfyui.safetensors` | [Pruna LoRA converted for ComfyUI](https://huggingface.co/NidAll/pruna-image-2.1-comfyui-loras) / [original Pruna models](https://huggingface.co/PrunaAI/Pruna-Qwen-Image-2.1) |
| `checkpoints/` | `sam3.1_multiplex_fp16.safetensors` | [Native SAM3.1 checkpoint](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/sam3.1/tree/main/checkpoints) |

The Pruna LoRA is enabled in the supplied 8-step swap subgraphs; removing it requires retuning Qwen sampling. BFS Head V1.1 can be replaced by another compatible BFS Qwen 2.1 head version. SAM3 weights are needed for masked guides; disabling masks skips guide segmentation, but the ComfyUI SAM3 Python module is still required to import Studio. The example decodes video only: the H3 audio VAE is not required by its current wiring. Add `minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32.safetensors` from the H3 VAE source only if adding generated-audio decoding; this workflow saves source audio.

This repository distributes workflow/code only, not model weights.
